set.excerpt: Applicants must have received at least 70% in their final secondary school grades (Elite, Advanced, Scientific, General, or Applied tracks) to join the Colleges of ... Business Administration ... Applicants must have achieved at least 70% (Elite, Advanced, or Scientific, General track) to be admitted to the College of Sciences and College of Computing and Informatics (Computer Science ...). For admission to Cybersecurity Engineering and Computer Engineering at the College of Computing and Informatics, the required grade is 75% (Elite, Advanced, or Scientific tracks) or 85% (General track). British Curriculum: completed Grade 12 or Year 13 ... A minimum of five O-Level subjects with grades no less than C and two AS-Level subjects with grades no less than D, or a minimum of six O-Level subjects with grades no less than C and one A-Level subject with a grade no less than E ... percentage calculated based on the grading scale adopted by the University of Sharjah. IB: full IB Diploma ... at least three subjects at Higher Level ... total of no less than 24 out of 45 points, and the student grade average will be determined by this score. American High School Diploma: 12 years of schooling ... minimum of six subjects ... attested and equated by the Ministry of Education. The high school grades mentioned are those of the UAE educational curriculum (Advanced Track) or their equivalents. Students who achieve a score of 5.5 in the IELTS test are exempted from remedial skill courses.
